episodes.name: Superman on Earth
episodes.overviewEn: Journey with Superman from Krypton to Metropolis, as he joins that Daily Planet staff and meets the fiery Lois Lane.

episodes.name: The Haunted Lighthouse
episodes.overviewEn:
A terrified Jimmy Olsen calls for help, and Superman speeds to an isolated island where strange things happen in the fog-shrouded night.

Commentary available by  TV Producer/Author Gary H. Grossman.

episodes.name: The Case of the Talkative Dummy
episodes.overviewEn: As superman hunts for kidnapped armored-car drivers and a stolen fortune, Jimmy, loccked inside a falling safe, hurtles to his doom.

episodes.name: Mystery of the Broken Statues
episodes.overviewEn: Lois Lane is kidnapped while on the trail of a suave but deadly criminal mastermind and a hidden priceless gem.

episodes.name: The Monkey Mystery
episodes.overviewEn: Searching for stolen defense secrets, Clark Kent encounters a brutalized woman, a slain organ-grinder -- and a monkey dressed as Superman.

episodes.name: Night of Terror
episodes.overviewEn: Superman races to find Lois Lane and Jimmy Olsen who wait, helplessly bound, as a sadistic hit man prepares to execute them.

episodes.name: The Birthday Letter
episodes.overviewEn: Superman is implicated in the abduction of a young girl who is thought to have information concerning hidden counterfeit plates.

episodes.name: The Mind Machine
episodes.overviewEn: Bravely testifying against a mobster, Lois Lane will die unless Clark Kent finds the weapon that will soon destroy her mind.

episodes.name: Rescue
episodes.overviewEn: Trapped in a mine filling with deadly gas, Lois Lane is beyond the reach of rescuers -- and Clark Kent doesn't know!

episodes.name: The Secret of Superman
episodes.overviewEn: An insane scientist, using powerful experimental truth drugs on Perry White, Lois Lane and Clark Kent, learns Superman's true identity.

episodes.name: No Holds Barred
episodes.overviewEn: When a crooked wrestling promoter paralyzes honest athletes, Superman steps in to reverse the damage and rescue an innocent captive.

episodes.name: The Deserted Village
episodes.overviewEn: As Clark Kent pursues the monster killing the few people left in Lois Lane's hometown, the girl reporter becomes its next victim.

episodes.name: The Stolen Costume
episodes.overviewEn:
After a burglar steals Superman's costume from Clark Kent's closet, a mobster threatens to reveal the Man of Steel's secret identity.

Commentary available by  TV Producer/Author Gary H. Grossman.

episodes.name: Treasure of the Incas
episodes.overviewEn: Unwittingly involved in a hunt for stolen radium, Jimmy is kidnapped and locked in a deathtrap by a fanatical doctor.

episodes.name: Double Trouble
episodes.overviewEn: Lois and Jimmy follow a trail of murder that could lead to ancient riches -- or to their own deaths.

episodes.name: Mystery in Wax
episodes.overviewEn: Lois Lane, chloroformed while investigating strange disappearances, is held prisoner in Madame Selina's wax museum of the living dead.

episodes.name: Runaway Robot
episodes.overviewEn: Captive Lois Lane will be murdered by gangsters unless inventor Horatio Hinkle uses his unique radio-controlled robot to rob banks.

episodes.name: Drums of Death
episodes.overviewEn: Aided by his ace reporters, Perry White flies to Haiti to search for his sister, the prisoner of a voodoo cult.

episodes.name: The Evil Three
episodes.overviewEn:
Perry White and Jimmy Olsen face death at the hands of three crazed murderers in a crumbling bayou hotel.

Commentary available by Producer/Writer Chuck Harter.

episodes.name: The Riddle of the Chinese Jade
episodes.overviewEn: Lois Lane is held hostage by the armed criminal who has stolen a priceless antique and left two people to drown.

episodes.name: The Human Bomb
episodes.overviewEn: On a windswept narrow ledge high above the ground, Lois Lane is chained to a dynamite-wielding daredevil ready to die.

episodes.name: Czar of the Underworld
episodes.overviewEn: A killer sabotaging the filming of a crime exposé stalks Clark Kent and Inspector Henderson on a Hollywood studio soundstage.

episodes.name: Ghost Wolf
episodes.overviewEn: After discovering human footprints that turn into wolf tracks, Lois Lane and Jimmy Olsen are trapped in a raging forest fire.

episodes.name: Crime Wave
episodes.overviewEn:
While hunting down an anonymous crime-boss, the Man of Steel is lured into a lighting-powered deathtrap that stops his heart.

Commentary available by Producer/Writer Chuck Harter.

episodes.name: The Unknown People (1)
episodes.overviewEn: Clark Kent and Lois Lane visit the world's deepest oil well in Silsby, when strange humanoid creatures appear and terrorize the townspeople.

episodes.name: The Unknown People (2)
episodes.overviewEn: Convinced the Mole Men are peaceful beings, Superman must save them from a vengeful mob determined to kill the armed visitors.

episodes.name: Five Minutes to Doom
episodes.overviewEn: Beat the clock:  The race is on to stop an innocent Death Row inmate's date with the electric chair.

episodes.name: The Big Squeeze
episodes.overviewEn: A powerful ally: the Man of Steel assists an ex-con blackmailed into returning to his criminal past.

episodes.name: The Man Who Could Read Minds
episodes.overviewEn: Swami says: send for Superman! Jimmy and Lois suspect a nightclub mind reader is linked to a theft ring.

episodes.name: Jet Ace
episodes.overviewEn: Look up! Superman rescues a pilot on a test flight gone wrong and later frees him from kidnappers seeking military secrets.

episodes.name: Shot in the Dark
episodes.overviewEn: An amateur shutterbug snaps some incriminating photos, one of which suggests Clark is you-know-who!

episodes.name: The Defeat of Superman
episodes.overviewEn: Superman is rendered powerless by a kryptonite trap. This sounds like a job for...Lois and Jimmy?

episodes.name: Superman in Exile
episodes.overviewEn: Beware of Superman! A nuclear incident leaves him glowing with radioactivity and lethal to anyone he's near.

episodes.name: A Ghost for Scotland Yard
episodes.overviewEn: Man or spirit? A magician believed dead may have resurfaced in a vendetta against his earthly foes.

episodes.name: The Dog Who Knew Superman
episodes.overviewEn: The nose knows. A dog rescued from a well by Superman keeps showing up at Clark Kent's office.

episodes.name: The Face and the Voice
episodes.overviewEn: Looks like him. Sounds like him. But he isn't Superman! A lookalike Man of Steel goes on a crime spree.

episodes.name: The Man in the Lead Mask
episodes.overviewEn: Surgically altered fingerprints. Lead masks to block x-ray vision. Will these foil the police and Superman?

episodes.name: Panic in the Sky
episodes.overviewEn:
Destination: Earth! Superman saves Metropolis from a plummeting asteroid -- and loses his memory in the process.

Commentary available by Jack Larson (Jimmy Olsen) and Noel Neill (Lois Lane).

episodes.name: The Machine That Could Plot Crimes
episodes.overviewEn: Meet Mr. Kelso, the computer that plans split second bank heists...and may know superman's secret, too.

episodes.name: Jungle Devil
episodes.overviewEn: The superhero saves a lost expedition, defeats a fearsome beast and uses his grip to turn coal into diamonds.

episodes.name: My Friend Superman
episodes.overviewEn: Burger, fries and friendship.  Not everyone believes a diner owner who boasts of being pals with Superman.

episodes.name: The Clown Who Cried
episodes.overviewEn: What kind of clown would rob a kids' charity telethon? An imposter clown, that's who!

episodes.name: The Boy Who Hated Superman
episodes.overviewEn: Clark is temporary guardian of a crime-connected youth who secretly plots revenge against the reporter.

episodes.name: Semi-Private Eye
episodes.overviewEn:
Sam Spade. Philip Marlowe. Jimmy Olsen? He poses as a trench-coated private eye to stalk kidnappers.

Commentary available by Jack Larson (Jimmy Olsen) and Noel Neill (Lois Lane).

episodes.name: Perry White's Scoop
episodes.overviewEn: Stop the presses! Frustrated by Daily Planet's reporters, Perry White decides to cover a murder story himself.

episodes.name: Beware the Wrecker
episodes.overviewEn: A terrorist bombs Metropolis' transportation systems. His method: armed, radio-controlled toy airplanes.

episodes.name: The Golden Vulture
episodes.overviewEn: Avast, ye scurvy mates! A salvage-boat captain who fancies himself a pirate holds Lois and Jimmy captive.

episodes.name: Jimmy Olsen, Boy Editor
episodes.overviewEn: Great Caesar's ghost! Jimmy Olsen replaces Perry White for a day -- with dizzy and dangerous results.

episodes.name: Lady in Black
episodes.overviewEn: Noises. Unusual people. Jimmy is sure something strange is going on at the apartment of his mom's friend.

episodes.name: Star of Fate
episodes.overviewEn: A mystery from Egypt's past: the antidote to an ancient poison is under the base of the Great Pyramid.

episodes.name: The Whistling Bird
episodes.overviewEn: The bird has the word. A per parakeet that knows an inventor's secret formula is mysteriously birdnapped.

episodes.name: Around the World with Superman
episodes.overviewEn: Paging Dr. Superman! His x-ray vision helps a surgeon restore a girl's sight, then he flies her on a world tour.

episodes.name: Through the Time Barrier
episodes.overviewEn: An inventor's time contraption whisks the Daily Planet staff to 50,000 B.C. One problem: how to get back!

episodes.name: The Talking Clue
episodes.overviewEn: Sound and fury. Bank robbers have a sudden interest in a young audiophile's collection of recorded sounds.

episodes.name: The Lucky Cat
episodes.overviewEn: Ladders, black cats, Friday the 13th. All harmless -- but someone intends real harm to an anti-superstition society.

episodes.name: Superman Week
episodes.overviewEn: No dinners, no hoopla...just Kryptonite.  Two thugs have their own way of celebrating Superman Week.

episodes.name: Great Caesar's Ghost
episodes.overviewEn: He claims to be Caesar. But who's really behind the strange apparition vexing Perry White?

episodes.name: Test of a Warrior
episodes.overviewEn: Great Horse faces his tribe's test of valor -- with help from a spirit named Superman!

episodes.name: Olsen's Millions
episodes.overviewEn: Gee, thanks! An elderly woman rewards Jimmy $1 million because she thinks he rescued her cat.

episodes.name: Clark Kent, Outlaw
episodes.overviewEn: Clark Kent is the man on the inside, posing as an ace safecracker to get the goods on a crime ring.

episodes.name: The Magic Necklace
episodes.overviewEn: Wear the necklace and it protects you from harm. Bullets even bounce off Clark when he wears it!

episodes.name: The Bully of Dry Gulch
episodes.overviewEn: His town. His way. But a bogus gunslinger who rules a Western town is no match for the Man of Steel.

episodes.name: Flight to the North
episodes.overviewEn: Good ol' boy Sylvester is mistaken for Superman.

episodes.name: The Seven Souvenirs
episodes.overviewEn: Is something hidden inside them? Items purchased at a Superman souvenir store may be clues to a crime.

episodes.name: King for a Day
episodes.overviewEn: A royal performance: Jimmy poses as a prince of Burgonia to help thwart an assassination plot.

episodes.name: Joey
episodes.overviewEn: A day at the races: Superman fights track corruption and the Daily Planet's racehorse gallops to victory.

episodes.name: The Unlucky Number
episodes.overviewEn: Guess the number of jelly beans in the jar. With superman's help, it's possible to win a fixed contest.

episodes.name: The Big Freeze
episodes.overviewEn: They'll stop him cold! Thugs think a freezer will keep Superman on ice during a rigged election.

episodes.name: Peril by Sea
episodes.overviewEn: Criminals aboard a submarine aim to torpedo Perry White and his seaside cottage to smithereens.

episodes.name: Topsy Turvy
episodes.overviewEn: Which way is up? An invention that causes the illusion of being upside-down is stolen for villainous use.

episodes.name: Jimmy the Kid
episodes.overviewEn: Who's that guy? Hoodlums kidnap Jimmy and put a tough-talking lookalike in his place at the Daily Planet.

episodes.name: The Girl Who Hired Superman
episodes.overviewEn: Villains have Superman right where they want him when he attends a party for a visiting foreign dignitary.

episodes.name: The Wedding of Superman
episodes.overviewEn: Superman pops the question, Lois says "yes". Is it a dream come true for the smitten femme reporter?

episodes.name: Dagger Island
episodes.overviewEn: Three brothers, one fortune.  Its finders keepers as the trio hunt for a hidden family inheritance.

episodes.name: Blackmail
episodes.overviewEn: A $500,000 heist -- and Inspector Henderson is the fall guy when some of the dough is planted on him.

episodes.name: The Deadly Rock
episodes.overviewEn: Mobsters use Kryptonite to capture the Man of Steel -- or at least a man they think is Superman!

episodes.name: The Phantom Ring
episodes.overviewEn: How do you stop thieves who have the power of invisibility? That's the new challenge facing Superman!

episodes.name: The Jolly Roger
episodes.overviewEn: Shiver me timbers! Pirates hold Clark, Lois and Jimmy on a deserted isle the U.S. Navy intends to destroy.

episodes.name: Peril in Paris
episodes.overviewEn: Good intentions gone bad. Superman helps a woman escape from behind the Iron Curtain...and inadvertently becomes a jewel smuggler.

episodes.name: Tin Hero
episodes.overviewEn: A nose for news: A meek bookkeeper is an ace crime reporter -- with an occasional assist from Superman.

episodes.name: The Town That Wasn't
episodes.overviewEn: You can't locate it on a map. What's the secret behind a tiny, mysterious, out-of-the-way town?

episodes.name: The Tomb of Zaharan
episodes.overviewEn: She's the one. Members of a bizarre cult believe Lois is their ancient queen returned to life.

episodes.name: The Man Who Made Dreams Come True
episodes.overviewEn: A bogus seer aims to make his own crooked dream come true - a plan to usurp the rule of a dotty monarch.

episodes.name: Disappearing Lois
episodes.overviewEn: She'll get all the dirt. Lois goes undercover, posing as a housemaid to get a story on a notorious criminal.

episodes.name: Money to Burn
episodes.overviewEn: Hot news: The arson suspect in a big warehouse fire is...Perry White!

episodes.name: Close Shave
episodes.overviewEn: A shave, a haircut, a new you, maybe a new life. A barber has an unusual influence on others.

episodes.name: The Phony Alibi
episodes.overviewEn: Dialed in: An inventor's new creation gives crooks the ability to zoom themselves through telephone lines.

episodes.name: The Prince Albert Coat
episodes.overviewEn: Oops! A boy gives his grandpa's coat to charity, unaware it holds the man's life savings. Can Superman save the savings?

episodes.name: The Stolen Elephant
episodes.overviewEn: And some kids just want a pony. A boy thinks the stolen circus elephant he finds is his birthday gift.

episodes.name: Mr. Zero
episodes.overviewEn: He's not from around here: A pint-sized Martian has a power that may be useful to crooks.

episodes.name: Whatever Goes Up
episodes.overviewEn: Jimmy Olsen: Scientist. The anti-gravity fluid he creates with his chemistry set draws interest from military men...and criminals.

episodes.name: The Last Knight
episodes.overviewEn: A gentlemen's society of armored knights holds many secrets (and holds jimmy and Lois captive, too).

episodes.name: The Magic Secret
episodes.overviewEn: Ready, Aim...A crimelord kidnaps Lois and Jimmy, using them as bait to lure our hero into the line of fire of a Kryptonite ray gun.

episodes.name: Divide and Conquer
episodes.overviewEn: Are half powers better than none? To be in two places at one time, Superman rearranges his molecular density.

episodes.name: The Mysterious Cube
episodes.overviewEn: Safe from justice? A killer hides inside a bunker made of a strange material even Superman can't penetrate.

episodes.name: The Atomic Captive
episodes.overviewEn: The bomb explodes, a mushroom cloud rises...and Lois and Jimmy are stranded on the test site.

episodes.name: The Superman Silver Mine
episodes.overviewEn: The kids can wait. Crooks attempt to claim a silver mine for themselves and keep it from becoming a summer camp.

episodes.name: The Big Forget
episodes.overviewEn: An anti-memory vapor can be useful to villains...and perhaps to Clark Kent when he needs to conceal his heroics.

episodes.name: The Gentle Monster
episodes.overviewEn: It means no harm. And may bring death to Superman. A newly created robot is powered by Kryptonite.

episodes.name: Superman's Wife
episodes.overviewEn: Sorry, Lois. Superman unexpectedly marries a gorgeous blonde policewoman. But why?

episodes.name: Three in One
episodes.overviewEn: Superman Arrested! While he's out of the way, three circus performers use their respective skills in a heist.

episodes.name: The Brainy Burro
episodes.overviewEn: Jimmy and Lois: bank robbers. They're accused of a theft committed by thugs and a mind-reading burro.

episodes.name: The Perils of Superman
episodes.overviewEn: Lois is tied to railroad track! Crooks in lead masks vow vengeance against the Daily Planet staff.

episodes.name: All That Glitters
episodes.overviewEn: What if? After a whack to the head, Jimmy dreams he and Lois have the same powers as the Man of Steel.
